verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a Dashboard could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server, llms.txt and CLI are building blocks for external agents, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
